description: Sturmschaden in Sachsen am 24.05.2010 is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geoh.conterra. The data set includes the forest damage areas in the Free State of Saxony caused by the storm event on 24 May 2010. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Storm damage in Saxony on 24.05.2010" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Natürlicher Lebensraum, Waldschaden, ab 24.05.2010, Schadgebiet, Kalamität, Wald. The listing shows 2018-05-15 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
